Name: CCBL (Community Center Bundle Ledger)
Author: Mourningpierrot
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Bundle Ledger helps you track the Community Center bundles in your current save, including normal and remixed runs.
[b]This mod is a MAJOR WIP![/b] Expect bugs, rough edges, and changes. For suggestions or feedback, contact [b]mourningpierrot[/b] on Discord.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI.[/url][/*]
[*]Download and extract the [b]BundleLedger[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and load your save.[/*]
[*]Press [b]B[/b] to open the bundle menu.[/*]
[/list][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Shows your save’s actual bundles, required items, quantities, and minimum quality.[/*]
[*]Tracks donated requirements.[/*]
[*]Displays combined owned counts from your backpack and supported storage without listing locations.[/*]
[*]Adds “Community Center” to item tooltips while the item is still needed.[/*]
[*]Includes a rebindable hotkey and optional Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer[/b][/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer[/url][/b][/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings through an in-game menu.[/*]
[/list][b][i][u][color=#ff0000]!![/color][color=#ffff00]Custom storage and multiplayer compatibility are still being tested[/color][color=#ff7700]!![/color][/u][/i][/b]
